name: oasdiff-f2d2e121-blind26-ots
instr:
# oasdiff: wrong answers all over the comparison output, to be diagnosed without a test suite

I use this program to compare two versions of an API description and be told what changed between them and whether any of it would break existing callers. Something went through this codebase and quietly changed one line here and one line there; the result is that a lot of unrelated runs now come back wrong, and nothing prints a warning while doing it. The repository has received 26 separate undocumented edits. What follows is what I actually did and what actually came back.

Asking what changed about what a client is allowed to send, the answers are wrong in several places at once. Comparing a base document against a revision that adds parameters to endpoints already present in both, the newly required query and header parameters and the newly optional ones are no longer listed the way they were; seven entries about added parameters used to come back, and what comes back now is another set entirely. The same trouble shows up when I list every change between two sample documents and ask for extra attributes to be carried through: the total count of entries is off, and the entry that should carry the beta and extension attributes is no longer where it was. When a parameter's schema has a property whose list of accepted types gains or loses a member, nothing is reported about that property being widened or narrowed, although the same widening and narrowing reported directly on the par
